answer: Make standing accrue over time rather than at the moment of creation. A fresh key starts in the dark — sable — and must earn graded passes across many epochs before its influence reaches its zenith. Sybils crave instant weight, and aging denies it because no one can forge a history that did not happen. A farm flooding new identities finds each one weak for weeks, while the decay clock quietly removes any it fails to keep active, so maintaining aged fakes costs far more than they return.
